title: Heavily · adv.
subtitle: 「大幅地／強烈地／很大程度上／嚴重地／密集地」，究竟是哪一種 heavily？
description: 「大幅地／強烈地／很大程度上／嚴重地／密集地」，究竟是哪一種 heavily？

words.meaning: 大幅地；相當程度地；實質上
words.note: 使用者提供。substantially 適合 heavily 表示數量、程度、成本、價格、影響或變化幅度很大，語氣較正式。它比 intensely 更偏 measurable degree / magnitude。
words.example: Costs increased substantially during the year.

exercises.original: The company invested heavily in new equipment last year.
exercises.zh: 公司去年大幅投資新設備。
exercises.upgrade: substantially · 大幅地；相當程度地；實質上

options.explanation: investment amount is the key issue; substantially naturally expresses a large financial degree.

falseSynonyms.zh: substantially 強調幅度／程度大，尤其適合正式、可量化變化；heavily 還可表示嚴重、密集或強烈。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Costs increased substantially. The area is heavily populated.

falseSynonyms.zh: intensely 強調感受、競爭或注意力強度；不是所有 heavily + verb 都自然改成 intensely。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They competed intensely. The company invested heavily.

falseSynonyms.zh: greatly 是較中性的高程度副詞，常配 improve/benefit/affect；heavily 更常帶負擔、強度或特殊搭配。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The change greatly improved access. The bridge was heavily damaged.

falseSynonyms.zh: severely 只適合嚴重負面後果；heavily invested / heavily populated 不能改成 severely。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The building was severely damaged. The district is heavily populated.

falseSynonyms.zh: strongly 適合立場、建議和影響；heavily 可表依賴、密度、嚴重程度等更廣義。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I strongly recommend it. The economy depends heavily on tourism.

falseSynonyms.zh: extensively 強調廣泛範圍或覆蓋面；heavily 可強調程度大而不一定範圍廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The system was extensively tested. The company was heavily criticised.

falseSynonyms.zh: densely 只處理人口、建築、樹木等空間密度；不是一般程度副詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The valley is densely wooded. The policy was heavily criticised.

falseSynonyms.zh: heavily 是副詞；heavy 主要是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON It rained heavily. The rain was heavy.
